name: Cross Ange - Tenshi to Ryuu no Rondo tr.
original_name: クロスアンジュ 天使と竜の輪舞tr.
source: An original story of the series with a new protagonist called Naomi and which is divided into 10 chapters. The game follows the beginning of the anime but then drifts into an alternative story. The game consists of two parts: Drama and Action. In Drama, you watch the story and events unfold while pursuing one of the heroines, and in Action, you fight against the DRAGONs and other enemies who come in the way. There is also a mode where you can touch the heroines.
translation: 该系列的原创故事，新主角名为Naomi，分为10章。游戏遵循动画的开头，但随后进入另一个故事。游戏由两部分组成：戏剧和动作。在戏剧中，你一边追寻一位女主角，一边观看故事和事件的展开；在行动中，你将与龙和其他挡道的敌人作战。还有可以触摸女主角的模式。
